title: BECE English Studies: Vocabulary & Register - English Studies - Synonyms
subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the word nearest in meaning to the bolded word:

The priest addressed the **congregation** after the morning service.
questions.explain: A 'congregation' specifically refers to a group of people gathered for religious worship. Therefore, 'worshippers' is the most accurate synonym in this context.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the word nearest in meaning to the bolded word:

Denying citizens their freedom of speech is a clear **infringement** on their basic rights.
questions.explain: An 'infringement' is an action that breaks a rule, law, or agreement. 'Violation' is its closest synonym in the context of human rights.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the word nearest in meaning to the bolded word:

HIV is a viral infection that can be **transmitted** through the sharing of unsterilized sharp objects.
questions.explain: To 'transmit' a disease means to pass it on or spread it from one person or place to another.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the word nearest in meaning to the bolded word:

The altar is considered a **sacred** place by all members of the church.
questions.explain: 'Sacred' implies something that is dedicated to a religious purpose and deserves veneration; its most direct synonym is 'holy'.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the word nearest in meaning to the bolded word:

The vendor was arrested for selling essential commodities at **exorbitant** prices during the artificial scarcity.
questions.explain: In a market context, 'exorbitant' refers to a price or amount charged that is unreasonably high. 'Outrageous' is the closest synonym.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the word nearest in meaning to the bolded word:

Following months of intense mediation, the two historically conflicting ethnic groups eventually reached an **amicable** settlement over the disputed land.
questions.explain: 'Amicable' describes relations between people or groups that have a spirit of friendliness, without serious disagreement or rancor. 'Cordial' is its closest synonym.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the word nearest in meaning to the bolded word:

The massive congregation stood in absolute, **reverent** silence as the bishop lifted the sacred elements.
questions.explain: 'Reverent' means feeling or showing deep, solemn respect, especially in a religious setting. 'Respectful' is the closest synonym here.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the word nearest in meaning to the bolded word:

The chief rehabilitation counselor instructed the recovering addict to entirely **abstain** from consuming any alcoholic beverages to avoid triggering a deadly relapse.
questions.explain: To 'abstain' means to actively restrain oneself from doing or enjoying something, especially something detrimental. 'Refrain' is the most accurate synonym.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the word nearest in meaning to the bolded word:

Despite administering heavily aggressive, extended courses of specialized chemotherapy, the oncologist solemnly informed the despairing family that the deep-seated tumor remained highly **malignant**.
questions.explain: In pathology and medicine, 'malignant' relates to tumors that are severe and progressively worsening due to uncontrolled cell growth, directly translating to 'cancerous'.
questions.subject: English Studies
